subject.title: fix(qa): stop deadline-bounded health probes from re-probing on timer jitter

question: Should this internal QA-runtime fix merge with repeated focused-test evidence, or should it first include a real QA Docker health-check run demonstrating the deadline and ordinary-timeout paths?
rationale: The patch appears mechanically sound, but the external-PR proof policy requires observed after-fix behavior rather than tests alone.

options.title: Require live QA proof
options.body: Request a redacted QA Docker health-check transcript or terminal capture proving one deadline-bounded probe and preserved ordinary-timeout retries before merge.

options.title: Accept focused-test evidence
options.body: Accept the repeated focused test as sufficient for this isolated internal polling correction and merge after exact-head checks complete.

recommendation.title: Require live QA proof
recommendation.body: Request a redacted QA Docker health-check transcript or terminal capture proving one deadline-bounded probe and preserved ordinary-timeout retries before merge.
